text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Lake Shore Boulevard West, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to recommend that the southerly eastbound curb lane on Lake Shore Boulevard West, from Silver Moon Drive to a point 30.5 metres west, be designated for eastbound right turns only. The proposed lane designation will clearly define lane usage and mitigate any potential vehicular conflicts.

City Council on June 24 and 25, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate the southerly eastbound lane on Lake Shore Boulevard West, between Silver Moon Drive and a point 30.5 metres west, for eastbound right turns only.
